nodes.name: GitHub list open issues
nodes.notes: H8562 v2: REST issue LIST, not the search API — the search index lags (review FAIL), the list endpoint is strongly consistent. The ops-soft-alert label is part of the issue contract (create always sets it; never strip). Scan window: 100 newest open soft-alert issues — add pagination before shipping if ever exceeded. Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

nodes.name: GitHub comment on existing
nodes.notes: A repeat delivery of an ACTIVE fingerprint comments on the lowest-numbered open issue instead of creating.

nodes.name: GitHub create issue
nodes.notes: Reachable ONLY from the IF-existing false branch. H8562 v2: the title is NOT rebuilt here — it reads expected_title from the Match exact title node, so the dedup phrase and the created title are the same string by construction. Failed-unit detection lives in the body (failures, playbook, suggested diagnose) — do not drop it.

nodes.name: GitHub reconcile list
nodes.notes: H8562 v2 post-create reconciliation over the consistent list: the rival that created the HIGHER number always sees the lower-numbered issue here (numbers are serial, the list reflects creates immediately) and closes exactly itself — both race orders converge, no retries, no lagged search index. Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

nodes.name: IF we are the duplicate
nodes.notes: Lowest-number-wins: close self only when an open issue with the exact title has a LOWER number than ours. Both concurrent orders converge on the earlier issue — no iteration, no search-index dependence.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: `Closed as duplicate of #${$json.rival.number} — concurrent soft-alert deliveries converge on one issue (H8562).` }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub close duplicate
nodes.notes: Closes exactly OUR own just-created issue — the URL pins the create node's number, never a rival's.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": true, "converged": true, "issue": $('GitHub create issue').first().json.html_url || null, "converged_into": $('Reconcile find rival').first().json.rival.html_url || null } }}

nodes.name: Sweep schedule
nodes.notes: H8562 v2 durable sweep every 6 h, independent of deliveries. First run after import closes the 21–23.11 storm backlog (46 duplicates, one comment each) — expected one-time close-notification burst. Rationale: docs/ops/SOFT_ALERT_WEBHOOK.md §4.

nodes.name: Sweep list open issues
nodes.notes: Same consistent list as the webhook flow. Scan window: 100 newest open ops-soft-alert issues — covers the 21–23.11 backlog (49) with margin.

nodes.name: Sweep close duplicate
nodes.notes: Per-item (n8n). Closes ONLY non-minimal duplicates; the survivor is never closed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: `Closed as duplicate — periodic soft-alert dedup sweep (H8562). Survivor: the lowest-numbered OPEN issue with the same title.` }) }}

nodes.name: Sweep comment duplicate
nodes.notes: $json is the PATCH response, so $json.number IS the duplicate. Commenting on a closed issue is the audit link.
